lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Stephanie Santin | Lesson 2 -- Two Careers, One Story

listenings.text: Hello. My name is Martin Oliveira, and I am a nurse. I have worked in intensive care for eleven years, and I have seen almost everything a hospital can show you. Two years ago something changed. My hospital started a project with a technology company, and they asked me to help. Since then I have been part of the team that designs the software the nurses use. I have not stopped nursing completely. I still work two nights a week, because I do not want to forget what the job feels like. People ask me if I have made the right decision. I think I have. I have found a way to help more patients than I could ever help alone.

Good afternoon. This is a message for all the doctors on the international program. We have received your documents, and we have already reviewed most of them. Three candidates have not sent the language certificate yet, so please check your email today. We have also changed one date: the first online meeting has moved from Tuesday to Thursday, at four in the afternoon, Brazilian time. It has been a long process, and we know that. Thank you for your patience. If you have any questions, write to the program office.
